overview.title: Business overview

products.title: My products

products.moqWarn: Stock is below your minimum order ({{moq}})

form.subtitle: Fill in the details buyers compare: price, stock, minimum order and delivery.

sections.productHint: Choose what you sell from the platform catalogue.
sections.priceHint: Wholesale price per unit in UZS.

form.lockedHint: Product, unit and region are fixed after publishing.
form.deliveryHint: Buyers filter by delivery — turn it on if you can ship.
form.noMarkets: No markets listed in this region
form.validHint: Leave empty for an open-ended offer
form.photoHint: A real photo builds trust. JPG, PNG or WebP up to 4 MB.
form.dropImage: Click or drop an image here
form.hintEmpty: Choose a product to see current market prices and where your price would sit.
form.hintNoData: No other active offers for this product yet — you set the benchmark.

verdict.low: Your price is {{pct}} vs. the market average — far below. Double-check it's not a typo.
verdict.below: {{pct}} vs. average — competitive, buyers will see you near the top.
verdict.above: {{pct}} vs. average — slightly above the market.
verdict.high: {{pct}} vs. average — well above the market; buyers may skip this offer.

errors.moqGtStock: Minimum order can't exceed available quantity
errors.pastDate: Date can't be in the past
errors.imageType: Only JPG, PNG or WebP images
errors.imageSize: Image must be 4 MB or smaller

requests.title: Incoming requests
requests.subtitle: Purchase requests from buyers. Accept, reject or send a counteroffer.
requests.emptyBody: When buyers request your offers they will appear here.
requests.counterBody: Propose your price to {{buyer}}. They can accept or cancel.
requests.messagePlaceholder: e.g. Price includes delivery to Tashkent

accept.title: Accept this request?
accept.body: {{buyer}} will be notified that you accept the deal.

reject.title: Reject this request?
reject.body: {{buyer}} will be notified. This cannot be undone.

complete.title: Mark as completed?
complete.body: Confirm the deal with {{buyer}} is done. It will count toward your completed deals.

analytics.title: Sales analytics
analytics.subtitle: Visibility, inquiries and how competitive each of your prices is.
analytics.viewsHint: Daily offer views with a 7-day rolling average
analytics.compHint: Your price vs. market min / average / max for each active offer
analytics.demandHint: Estimated interest and supply for your products

intel.title: Market intelligence
intel.subtitle: Prices, regional spread, forecast and supply–demand for any product.
intel.aiQuestion: Analyse the wholesale market for {{product}}: price trend, regional differences and what price I should set.
intel.noOwnProducts: You have no offers yet — pick any product on the right.
intel.pickBody: Select one of your products or any product from the catalogue.
intel.noHistory: Not enough price history for this period
intel.forecastHint: Statistical projection from price history — not a guarantee.
intel.insufficientTitle: Not enough data for a forecast
intel.insufficientBody: We have {{points}} daily price points; a reliable forecast needs at least {{min}}. It will appear automatically as more prices are recorded.
intel.supplyDemandHint: Observed platform metrics on the left, estimated indicators on the right.

profile.title: Business profile
profile.subtitle: What buyers see about your business, and your verification status.
profile.formHint: Shown on your supplier page and on every offer.
profile.descriptionHint: What you sell, volumes, where you deliver, working hours.

errors.noteMin: Describe the documents in at least 10 characters

verified.title: Verified supplier
verified.body: Your documents were checked. Buyers see the verified badge on your offers.

pending.title: Under review
pending.body: An administrator is checking your documents. This usually takes 1–2 working days.

rejected.title: Verification rejected
rejected.body: See the reviewer's note below, fix the issue and submit a new request.

unverified.title: Not verified
unverified.body: Submit your registration documents (TIN, certificate) to get the verified badge.

profile.documentHint: List the documents and their numbers, e.g. TIN, state registration certificate.
